grid.test: two-sided score test at the null fit, clustered by session through an exchangeable within-session correlation (the test that decides H2a and H2b)

pilot.shape_note: Session shape from the exploratory pilot, whose plans are not padded to 20 subtasks and force 1 to 3 compactions in [8, 120); E1 pads plans (D-043) and forces 1 or 2 compactions in [8, 70) (D-047), so its sessions are longer and see more compactions before their decision points (unpadded pilot shape), which raises the power for the compaction effect. The simulation also places compactions at uniformly random times, while E1's token-budget compactions recur at nearly regular intervals, which ties the compaction count to position and lowers that power, so the simulated compaction power can be too high or too low for E1.
